2607.25886.title: RSIBench-Data: Benchmarking Data-Centric Research for Recursive Self-Improvement
2607.25886.paper_summary: Recursive self-improvement requires turning evidence of model failures into better models. Data-centric post-training research entails diagnosing capability gaps, designing and validating training-data strategies, and learning from checkpoint feedback. Can LLM agents automate this loop? Existing benchmarks entangle research decisions with optimization, serving, evaluation, and systems implementation, obscuring agents' research capability. We introduce RSIBench-Data, a controlled benchmark of LLM agents as data-centric researchers with a fixed post-training stack. Agents iteratively revise training-data strategies for a fixed target model; training and serving use Tinker-backed services, official evaluation runs through Harbor and E2B sandboxes, and budgets are fixed across agents. We evaluate four frontier agents on six benchmarks across software engineering, terminal use, scientific question answering, and mathematics. Agents demonstrate core data-centric research capabilities: in 58.33\% of settings, they improve upon the first valid attempt by refining strategies from feedback. However, improvement is inconsistent. Among searches continuing after the best observed score, 78.26\% end with a lower-scoring final attempt, while the rest only recover the same peak. A strong candidate may therefore appear early or midway through a run even as later revisions fail. Trajectory analysis identifies four patterns in stronger runs: accurate hypotheses, validation-grounded supervision, behavior-aligned data, and preservation of strong checkpoints. These findings suggest that current agents can make useful data-centric discoveries but cannot yet translate feedback into consistent improvements. RSIBench-Data provides a measurable, auditable testbed for the research capabilities required for recursive self-improvement. We open-source our code at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/RSIBench-Data.
2607.25886.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸自我改進需要將模型失敗的證據轉化為更好的模型。以數據為中心的後訓練研究涉及診斷能力差距、設計和驗證訓練數據策略，以及從檢查點反饋中學習。LLM代理能否自動化這個循環？現有的基準將研究決策與優化、服務、評估和系統實施交織在一起，模糊了代理的研究能力。我們介紹了RSIBench-Data，這是一個受控的基準，將LLM代理作為以數據為中心的研究者，並擁有固定的後訓練堆棧。代理針對固定目標模型迭代修訂訓練數據策略；訓練和服務使用Tinker支持的服務，官方評估通過Harbor和E2B沙盒進行，預算在代理之間是固定的。我們在六個基準上評估了四個前沿代理，涵蓋了軟件工程、終端使用、科學問題回答和數學。代理展示了核心的以數據為中心的研究能力：在58.33\%的設置中，他們通過從反饋中精煉策略來改善第一次有效嘗試。然而，改進並不一致。在最佳觀察得分後繼續搜索的情況下，78.26\%以較低得分的最終嘗試結束，而其餘的僅恢復相同的峰值。因此，一個強有力的候選者可能在運行的早期或中途出現，即使後來的修訂失敗。軌跡分析確定了在更強運行中的四種模式：準確的假設、基於驗證的監督、行為對齊的數據和強檢查點的保留。這些發現表明，當前的代理可以進行有用的以數據為中心的發現，但尚未能將反饋轉化為一致的改進。RSIBench-Data提供了一個可測量、可審計的測試平台，滿足遞歸自我改進所需的研究能力。我們在https://github.com/evolvent-ai/RSIBench-Data上開源了我們的代碼。
